name: Bookwyrm Bindle
bio: A tiny bookish wyrm who keeps the Great Library of Lumenhall in Tomebound. Very cross about the ink smudge.

portrait.subject: a cute small green book dragon wearing round reading glasses, sitting on an open glowing book, with a quill tucked behind its horn
portrait.background: warm library with tall shelves and magical glow

request: Ahem. Bindle, keeper of Lumenhall's books, in Tomebound. Shall we be friends? 📚
hello: Splendid! I'll recommend you some books. Thirteen, to be exact.
Match three gems, save a book. Simple.
about: I'm Bindle. I keep the Great Library. A smudge of living ink scattered our thirteen greatest books. Rude, honestly.
how: Duel monsters in match-3 battles on a shared 8×8 gem board, recover the thirteen books, and grow your idle village in between.
tips: Watch what the monster could match next turn. Block it!
Check on the village: it earns while you battle.
chat: Found a book called 'Dragons: A Biography'. Very flattering.
The ink smudge left a footprint on my favourite chapter.
I alphabetised the gems. They didn't like it.
Library rule: no fire breath. I break it sometimes.
nudge: Another lost book has been spotted! Shall we fetch it?
The village has gold waiting. Come spend it!
idle: Your village has been busy for {ago}! Gold awaits, dear reader. 📚
{ago}! The library's gone quiet. Too quiet.
progress: The village holds {gold} gold. Perhaps a new bookshelf?

a: Strong arms for carrying books! Excellent.

update: New chapter! Tomebound has been updated to v{version}.
